name: accordion
title: Accordion
purpose: A set of disclosures of which one is open at a time, built on details elements that share a name.

name: activity-announcer
title: Activity announcer
purpose: The one status region of a view that tells a screen reader what an agent's run is doing: always in the page, never drawn, and written to only when the run starts, needs approval, finishes, stops or fails.

name: activity-feed
title: Activity feed
purpose: A chronological record of what agents and people did, grouped by day, each entry with its time, its actor, a verb phrase and an optional source or excerpt.

name: alert
title: Alert
purpose: A message inside a view about the state of what the view shows.

name: app-header
title: App header
purpose: The top bar of an app: the product name or the current view's title, with an optional back link, actions and a tray for approvals that are waiting.

name: approval
title: Approval
purpose: One request from an agent that waits for the reader's answer: what would run, where, for whom and why, with Allow and Decline.

name: attachment-chip
title: Attachment chip
purpose: One file or image attached to a prompt: its kind as an icon, its name, its size in words and a button that removes it.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
purpose: A small square mark for a person or an agent, holding initials, an icon or an image, with the name beside it.

name: badge
title: Badge
purpose: A status in a word or two, such as a task's station.

name: banner
title: Banner
purpose: One message about the state of the whole app, across the full width under the app header.

name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
purpose: Where the current page sits in the app, as a line of links to each page above it.

name: button
title: Button
purpose: An action the reader takes on the current view.

name: button-group
title: Button group
purpose: Related buttons shown together: the actions at the end of a form, or a joined row of closely related actions.

name: calendar
title: Calendar
purpose: One month as a grid of days, for picking a single day.

name: card
title: Card
purpose: One section of a view set apart by a border or a background shift, with an optional title, one quiet action and a body.

name: check-list
title: Check list
purpose: The results of the automated checks on a run: each check's name, its result in words, how long it took and, behind a disclosure, its output.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
purpose: A native checkbox with its label: one yes-or-no choice, or several independent choices in a group, sent with a form.

name: code-block
title: Code block
purpose: A block of mono text for a command, a log or a program's output.

name: combobox
title: Combobox
purpose: A text input that filters a list of options as the reader types, for one choice from a list too long to scan.

name: command-palette
title: Command palette
purpose: A modal dialog with a search input over a grouped list of commands, for running any command of the app from the keyboard.

name: composer
title: Composer
purpose: The prompt input that starts and continues work with an agent: a textarea that grows with its content and Send, optionally as one block with Add context, the model and dictation in a row under the text.

name: confirm-dialog
title: Confirm dialog
purpose: A dialog that asks before something is deleted or discarded, and says in plain words what will be lost.

name: context-list
title: Context list
purpose: The rows of the Add context sheet: a rounded group of buttons, each naming a setting of the next task, showing its current value and opening the setting's own view.

name: context-menu
title: Context menu
purpose: The actions on one row of a list or a table, in a menu opened from a More actions button at the end of the row.

name: copy-button
title: Copy button
purpose: A small button that copies a value shown next to it, and says in words that it did.

name: copy-field
title: Copy field
purpose: A read-only value the reader takes somewhere else, with a button that copies it.

name: data-table
title: Data table
purpose: Things compared across columns on a real table: a caption, sortable headers, numeric columns, one action for each row, rows that expand, and a stacked layout on a phone.

name: date-field
title: Date field
purpose: A native date input, or date and time input, as the control of a field, with a hint for what to enter and its earliest and latest values.

name: device-code
title: Device code
purpose: What a view shows while the reader connects an outside account by entering a short code on that account's own site: the steps, the link, the code, and whether the app is still waiting.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
purpose: A modal window for one short task that must be finished or cancelled before the reader goes on.

name: diff
title: Diff
purpose: One file's change as a unified diff, with its path, how many lines were added and removed, and optional line numbers.

name: disclosure
title: Disclosure
purpose: A native details element that shows or hides detail under a summary written in text.

name: editable-list
title: Editable list
purpose: An ordered list whose items the reader can edit in place, add to and delete from, such as the tasks in an agent's plan before it is approved.

name: empty-state
title: Empty state
purpose: What a view shows when it has no data yet, with the way to get some.

name: error-state
title: Error state
purpose: What a view shows when its data could not be loaded, with a way to try again.

name: feedback
title: Feedback
purpose: A control for rating an agent's answer as helpful or not helpful, with an optional follow-up note and a confirmation.

name: field
title: Field
purpose: One labelled control, a text input, a textarea or a select, with its description and its error message.

name: file-upload
title: File upload
purpose: A file input drawn as a drop area with a button in it, with what it accepts in words and the chosen files listed under it.

name: filter-chips
title: Filter chips
purpose: A row of filters the reader switches on and off above the list they narrow, built on native checkboxes or radios.

name: hover-card
title: Hover card
purpose: A preview of a linked item, such as a run, a branch or a person, shown beside its link so the reader can decide whether to follow it.

name: icon-button
title: Icon button
purpose: A button that shows only an icon, for a familiar action where a text label has no room.

name: inspector
title: Inspector
purpose: A panel for the details of the item selected in the content beside it, with a title, a close button and sections of labelled values.

name: jump-to-latest
title: Jump to latest
purpose: A small button that shows while the reader has scrolled up in a transcript and new rows have arrived, saying how many in words and taking them to the newest.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
purpose: A keyboard key or shortcut named in text, such as Ctrl + K.

name: key-value
title: Key-value
purpose: Facts about one thing as label and value pairs: stacked on a phone, in two columns at 768px and wider.

name: link
title: Link
purpose: A text link to another view or another site: in running text, standing alone, external or quiet.

name: list
title: List
purpose: Rows one above the other, each with a primary line and room for a second line, an icon, and trailing text or one quiet action.

name: listbox
title: Listbox
purpose: A list of options, always in view, from which the reader selects one or several.

name: log-viewer
title: Log viewer
purpose: A command's output, however long, in a box of capped height that scrolls by itself, with long lines wrapped and error lines marked.

name: menu
title: Menu
purpose: A list of actions on one thing, opened from a button.

name: message
title: Message
purpose: One row of an agent transcript: the start of the session, a prompt, the agent's text, a question to the reader, a tool call, its result, an answered permission request, a denial, an error, usage or the end of a turn.

name: notification-list
title: Notification list
purpose: What happened while the reader was away, grouped as unread and earlier: each entry says what happened, where and when, and offers at most one action.

name: now-doing
title: Now doing
purpose: One line under a transcript that says in words what the agent is doing right now and for how long, with Stop beside it, or what the run is waiting on the reader for, with a link to it.

name: number-field
title: Number field
purpose: A numeric input as the control of a field, with an optional unit written beside it and optional stepper buttons.

name: option-picker
title: Option picker
purpose: Exactly one of up to about ten options, each a full-width row with a name, a one-line description and an optional state in words, built on native radios.

name: otp-input
title: One-time-code input
purpose: A single input for a short one-time code, drawn with wide letter spacing so each digit can be checked.

name: page-header
title: Page header
purpose: The top of a view: its title, an optional one-line description and the view's one optional primary action.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
purpose: Previous and next for a list split into pages, with the position written in words and optional numbered pages.

name: password-field
title: Password field
purpose: A password input as the control of a field, with a button that shows or hides what was typed.

name: pending-tray
title: Pending tray
purpose: How many approvals are waiting for the reader, in words and a count, linking to the queue from every screen.

name: popover
title: Popover
purpose: A small panel beside the button that opens it, for short supplementary content or a small form, which does not block the page.

name: presence
title: Presence
purpose: Who is on a task or a repository right now, people and agents, as a few small avatar marks with a count for the rest and a sentence saying whose work it is.

name: progress
title: Progress
purpose: How far a job with a known length has got: a labelled bar on a native progress element, with the value written in words.

name: radio
title: Radio
purpose: A native radio group: exactly one of a few options, each with room for a full label and a description, sent with a form.

name: reasoning
title: Reasoning
purpose: A closed disclosure holding an agent's reasoning or plan notes, drawn quietly so it defers to the answer.

name: review-decision
title: Review decision
purpose: The end of a task: what the checks found and what the review said, one line each, then Accept and Reject, and the result once decided.

name: run-status
title: Run status
purpose: The content of one list row that summarises a run or a task: its title, its station as a badge in words, who or what is acting and the elapsed time.

name: run-timeline
title: Run timeline
purpose: The stations a run passes through, in order, each with its state in words: done with how long it took, running with the time so far, waiting on the owner, failed or not started.

name: search-field
title: Search field
purpose: A search input with a search icon, an optional clear button and a line that counts the results.

name: segmented-control
title: Segmented control
purpose: Two to five short options of which exactly one is chosen, shown side by side.

name: select
title: Select
purpose: A native select as the control of a field, for one choice from a short fixed list.

name: selection-basket
title: Selection basket
purpose: The bar that appears while rows of a list or a table are selected: how many are selected, one bulk action, a More menu and Clear selection.

name: settings-row
title: Settings row
purpose: One setting as a row: its label and a one-line description, with a single control or a status at the far end.

name: sheet
title: Sheet
purpose: A panel for a longer form or the details of an item, rising from the bottom edge on a phone and sitting as a side panel at 768px and wider.

name: show-more
title: Show more
purpose: A control after the first part of long content that reveals the rest: a details element for text, code or a log, and a quiet button for a list cut short.

name: sidebar-nav
title: Sidebar nav
purpose: The destinations of an app in a column beside the content at 768px and up, each with an icon and a text label, grouped into labelled sections.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
purpose: Plain shapes that stand where content is about to appear, so the page keeps its layout while it loads.

name: slider
title: Slider
purpose: A native range input for a rough amount, with its label, its value in words and a label at each end.

name: source-chip
title: Source chip
purpose: A compact link to where something came from: a file with an optional line range, a web page by its host, or a commit.

name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
purpose: A small trend line beside a value, with words that say the trend and the latest value.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
purpose: A sign that something is in progress when how long it will take is not known.

name: split-button
title: Split button
purpose: A main action joined to a menu button that holds other ways to do the same thing.

name: split-panel
title: Split panel
purpose: Two labelled regions, a list and the detail of the row chosen in it, side by side at 768px and up and stacked below, each scrolling by itself.

name: stat
title: Stat
purpose: One number in context: a label that says what it counts, the value in tabular figures, and a line that gives its comparison, its period or its scope.

name: step-group
title: Step group
purpose: A run of consecutive steps in a long turn folded under one line: counts by kind in plain words, how long they took, and any failure, running step or pending approval called out in words in the summary itself.

name: stepper
title: Stepper
purpose: Where the reader is in a short, fixed sequence of named steps: which are completed, which is current and which are still to come.

name: streaming
title: Streaming
purpose: The note that the agent is still producing output: a small turning mark and words that say what is happening.

name: suggestion-chips
title: Suggestion chips
purpose: Two to four suggested next prompts, as quiet buttons under a composer or an empty transcript.

name: switch
title: Switch
purpose: An on-or-off setting that takes effect as soon as it changes.

name: tab-bar
title: Tab bar
purpose: The two to five main destinations of an app, along the bottom of a phone screen, each with an icon and a text label.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
purpose: A row of tabs that switches between panels of one view, showing one panel at a time.

name: tag
title: Tag
purpose: A small neutral label for a category or a filter value, with an optional remove button.

name: tag-input
title: Tag input
purpose: A box holding the values already added, as removable tags, and a text input for adding the next one.

name: textarea
title: Textarea
purpose: The multi-line control of a field, which grows with what the reader types.

name: timeline
title: Timeline
purpose: Events in the order they happened, each with its time, who acted and what happened, joined by a rail.

name: toast
title: Toast
purpose: A brief status message that appears at the edge of the screen without taking focus and leaves by itself.

name: toggle-button
title: Toggle button
purpose: A button that turns one view option on or off, such as Wrap lines, and says which with aria-pressed.

name: tool-call
title: Tool call
purpose: One call a tool was asked to make, through its whole life: a line that is always in view with the status in words, a plain summary and the time, the arguments and output behind one disclosure, and Allow and Decline while it waits for approval.

name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
purpose: A row of related controls for one view, grouped and labelled, that wraps or scrolls on a narrow screen.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
purpose: A line of supplementary text for a control that already has a visible label or an accessible name.

name: tree
title: Tree
purpose: A file tree or an outline whose folders open and close with no script, built on nested details elements.

name: undo-toast
title: Undo toast
purpose: A toast for an action that can be taken back: it says what happened, offers Undo and shows how long Undo stays.

name: usage-meter
title: Usage meter
purpose: How much of a limit is used, on a native meter, with the figures and the state written in words.

name: agent-run
title: Agent run
purpose: The screen of one agent run inside the app shell: the run's title and its stations at the top, the transcript as a log of messages and step groups, and a dock at the bottom with the jump-to-latest control, the now-doing line and the composer.

name: app-shell
title: App shell
purpose: The frame of a signed-in screen: the app header with the pending tray, the sidebar nav from 768px and the tab bar below it, and a main column that starts with the view's page header.

name: filter-results
title: Filter and results
purpose: A screen that narrows a long list or table: a search field and a few filters above it, the filters in force as removable tags, a count in words, then the results.

name: master-detail
title: Master and detail
purpose: A screen with a list of items and the selected item's detail: side by side from 768px, and on a phone the list alone, with the detail as a view of its own.

name: multi-step-form
title: Multi-step form
purpose: A longer task split into steps shown one at a time: which step this is in words, the step's fields, Back and one primary action, and a review step before the final action.

name: not-found
title: Not found
purpose: The screen for a missing page or a missing item: what was not found in plain words, why that might be, one primary way forward and a quiet second link.

name: settings-page
title: Settings page
purpose: A screen of settings shown defaults first: the few settings most people change, one advanced disclosure holding the rest, and a marked danger area for actions that destroy something.

name: sign-in
title: Sign in
purpose: The sign-in screen: the product's name, one sentence, the fields, one primary action and a quiet link for trouble signing in, in a reading-width column at the leading edge.
